title: cyanus triumfettii subsp. strictus
intro: Cyanus triumfettii subsp. strictus, commonly known as the strict cornflower, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. The strict cornflower is known for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat various health conditions. The plant is reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions like arthritis and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the strict cornflower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
